name: WP-MVP-0004 EOSV reconciliation runner

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "ops/wp-mvp-0004-eosv-runner-20260826"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  reconcile-eosv:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt
      TARGET_BRANCH: gov/wp-mvp-0004-post-merge-reconciliation
      EXPECTED_TARGET_HEAD: be0bc8ee12636b96ff626707b9810ae5dbf923cf
      EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD: 6793ae3085d372ac3a30bec65c5578b29149d223
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact governance branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gov/wp-mvp-0004-post-merge-reconciliation
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install governed Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: "1.95.0"
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Guard remote authority and branch head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git fetch origin main "$TARGET_BRANCH"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_TARGET_HEAD"
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"
          test "$(git rev-parse "origin/$TARGET_BRANCH")" = "$EXPECTED_TARGET_HEAD"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD" HEAD
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Prove pre-mutation fixed point
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Revalidate merged WP-MVP-0004 product
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo test --workspace
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          git diff --check

      - name: Enter EOSV and capture initial evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0004 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0009
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit EOSV semantic transition with strict scope guard
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          mapfile -t changed < <({ git diff --name-only; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u)
          test "${#changed[@]}" -gt 0
          for f in "${changed[@]}"; do
            case "$f" in
              .eos/*|engineering/evidence/*|engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md|machine/*) ;;
              *) echo "Out-of-scope EOSV path: $f" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
          done
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -- "${changed[@]}"
          git commit -m "chore(eosv): enter WP-MVP-0004 verification after merge"

      - name: Refresh WP-MVP-0004 evidence against committed VERIFYING state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0004 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0009
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit refreshed exact-state evidence with strict scope guard
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          mapfile -t changed < <({ git diff --name-only; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u)
          test "${#changed[@]}" -gt 0
          for f in "${changed[@]}"; do
            case "$f" in
              .eos/*|engineering/evidence/*|engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md|machine/*) ;;
              *) echo "Out-of-scope evidence-refresh path: $f" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
          done
          git add -- "${changed[@]}"
          git commit -m "chore(eosv): refresh WP-MVP-0004 verification evidence"

      - name: Prove final EOSV fixed point and lifecycle invariants
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo test --workspace
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          git diff --check
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import csv
          from pathlib import Path
          rows = {r['id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(Path('.eos/work-packets.tsv').open(), delimiter='\t')}
          assert rows['WP-MVP-0001']['status'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert rows['WP-MVP-0002']['status'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert rows['WP-MVP-0003']['status'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert rows['WP-MVP-0004']['status'] == 'VERIFYING'
          wc = {r['id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(Path('.eos/work-cycles.tsv').open(), delimiter='\t')}
          assert wc['WC-MVP-0002']['status'] == 'ACTIVE'
          pi = {r['id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(Path('.eos/program-increments.tsv').open(), delimiter='\t')}
          assert pi['PI-MVP-001']['status'] == 'ACTIVE'
          ev = [r for r in csv.DictReader(Path('.eos/evidence.tsv').open(), delimiter='\t') if r['target'] == 'WP-MVP-0004' and r['status'] == 'VALIDATED']
          assert len(ev) == 3, ev
          assert {r['execution'] for r in ev} == {'EXEC-0009'}, ev
          assert all(r['result'] in {'PASSED', 'SKIPPED'} for r in ev), ev
          print('WP-MVP-0004 current evidence:', ', '.join(r['id'] for r in ev))
          PY

      - name: Push normal fast-forward governance commits
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git push origin "HEAD:$TARGET_BRANCH"
